title: View-only invitations: automated checks passed
summary: The link invitation, approval, automatic device handoff and host-enforced view-only flow passed automated checks. New Android builds and physical two-phone verification are still required.
components: Android phone capture and invitation server

changes.detail: Corrected strict parser types and React lifecycle lint findings; checks native sharing status before accepting a link, preserves in-flight delivery retries and avoids automatic saved-session restoration over invitation consent.
Existing sharing screen shows view-only status after returning to an active view-only session; Accessibility settings and control-mode QR prompt are hidden for that active session.
Regression coverage for explicit consent, send-link-to-viewer handoff, hidden controls, server-side control denial, authenticated invitation delivery, duplicate response recovery and expiry.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck completed with exit code 0.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: ESLint passed for app/phone.tsx, components/PhoneInvitation.tsx, components/PhoneViewer.tsx and utils/phone-invitation.ts. Initial ref/effect lint findings were corrected.

validation.name: JavaScript interaction and history regression tests
validation.detail: 25 tests passed across invitation, phone page, direct viewer, QR, native viewer, secure sessions, append-only history and history UI persistence/expansion.

validation.name: Native protocol tests
validation.detail: 13 JUnit tests passed against the real NanoHTTPD loopback servers, including view-only control rejection and invitation authentication/idempotency/expiry.

validation.name: Android Kotlin compilation
validation.detail: All native/phone production Kotlin sources compiled against cached Android, React Native, OkHttp, Okio and NanoHTTPD dependencies. Existing deprecation/parameter-name warnings remain. This is source compilation, not a full APK build.

validation.name: Physical phones, installation and deployment
validation.detail: No APK built or installed and no deployment performed. Requires updated Android builds on both phones and Tailscale TCP 8093/8092 access. Real share-sheet/custom-link handling, screen capture, app switching, lock/rotation and two-phone behavior remain untested.
